name: Lucky Us: Fall by Chance
source:
University life hasn’t been all that you have envisioned. The glamorous college experience portrayed in TV shows and movies feels far from your reality. So, when the chance presented itself, you decided to try out for the school’s football team —and somehow, managed to snag a spot. 

Now you find yourself thrust into a world full of charisma, intensive workouts, and attractive athletes.  Although you may be out of your depth, who knows?  With some hard work and a bit of luck, you may get an exciting future.

[From [url=https://beribeardraw.itch.io/lucky-us]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
大学生活并不如你想象的那样。电视节目和电影中描绘的迷人大学经历与现实相去甚远。因此，当机会出现时，你决定参加学校橄榄球队的比赛，并且不知何故，设法获得了一个席位。

现在你发现自己进入了一个充满魅力、高强度锻炼和有吸引力的运动员的世界。虽然你可能超出了你的深度，但谁知道呢？通过一些努力和一点运气，你可能会获得令人兴奋的未来。

[来自[url=https://beribeardraw.itch.io/lucky-us]Itch.io[/url]]
